rationale: Evidence-weighted comparison of all ten accepted deep reviews; not a sorted price ranking, empirical portfolio EV or verified unrestricted donation offers. HFC and Doctors have inspectable current services and costs; RTC has direct delivered repair mechanisms; Cultivando has current original legal controls but conditional exposure benefits. HRAC and KIND remain donor HOLDs. All four require donor-capacity follow-up.
